description: This Java source file defines the 'DigitalWatchFaceConfigListenerService' class, which extends 'WearableListenerService' and handles incoming messages to update watch face configurations on an Android Wear OS device. It manages connections to GoogleApiClient and processes DataMap configurations received via messages.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceConfigListenerService
classes.description: A service class that listens for configuration messages related to a digital watch face and updates its configuration using GoogleApiClient when messages are received.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, checks the path, extracts configuration data, and initiates GoogleApiClient connection to update watch face settings.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when the GoogleApiClient successfully connects; currently logs the connection event.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when the GoogleApiClient connection is suspended; logs the cause.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback when the GoogleApiClient connection fails; logs the failure.
